name: SP Jain School of Global Management, Dubai
englishBachelors: One bachelor's degree is delivered in Dubai: the Bachelor of Business Administration, studied across Singapore or Dubai and Sydney. The Bachelor of Data Science is delivered in Sydney only.
note: Unusual structure: undergraduates rotate between campuses in Dubai, Singapore, Sydney and Mumbai across the degree, which makes it a genuine multi-city education rather than a single-country one. Australian-accredited.
summary: Four-year Australian-awarded BBA with years 1 and 2 in Singapore or Dubai and years 3 and 4 in Sydney. Dubai is one of two first-year campuses for September 2027.
about: SP Jain's BBA moves you between cities: for September 2027 year 1 is in Dubai or Singapore, year 2 in Dubai and years 3 and 4 in Sydney. The degree is an Australian award, so the Sydney years are on a student visa.

ib.text: IB Diploma of 24 or more points meets the academic rule (12 years of schooling). No subject or grade minimums are published. No rule for IB Course Results; other qualifications are assessed.

lastYear.text: Page states 31 Aug 2026 for the Jan/Sep 2027 intakes

notes: Where you study: for September 2027 the fee page lists year 1 in Singapore or Dubai (2027-28), year 2 in Dubai (2028-29) and years 3 and 4 in Sydney (2029-31). The Dubai campus orientation is 3 to 6/7 September 2027. This is a multi-city degree: you do not stay in the UAE for all four years. Old intake tables on the programme page date from 2022 and should not be used.

Recognition: the BBA is described as an Australian degree (AQF Level 7, CRICOS 077570G). The SP Jain Dubai site says the programme is accredited by the UAE Commission for Academic Accreditation; that page also carries 2021-era text, so confirm the current UAE status and degree attestation with the school.

IB: the academic eligibility rule accepts an IB Diploma of 24 or more points, as one of several routes (12 years of schooling). No subject, level or grade minimums are published. Admission is subject to approval by the Admissions Committee. No rule for IB Course Results was found.

English: applicants whose most recent education was not in English need IELTS 6, TOEFL iBT 60, PTE 50 or Duolingo 85. Those who completed schooling in English give certified evidence instead. Students for Sydney may need to meet the Australian student-visa English rules. The pages do not state the teaching language in a sentence; the English rule implies English.

Dates: the BBA and admissions pages state 'Application Deadline: August 31, 2026' while listing the January and September 2027 intakes as open. That date has passed, so check the real September 2027 deadline with admissions. Dubai orientation for September 2027 is 3 September 2027.

Tuition for September 2027 entry (compulsory, two semesters): year 1 Dubai USD 28,300; year 2 Dubai USD 30,800; year 3 Sydney AUD 45,400; year 4 Sydney AUD 48,200. Dubai also lists a visa fee of USD 1,700 and insurance USD 500 a year. Applicant group: all, the page shows no residency split. Housing and living costs are not on the fee page.

The Bachelor of Data Science (3 years) and Bachelor of Economics (2.5 years) are on-campus in Sydney only, so they are not listed as Dubai degrees. A 'Bachelor of Business Communication' appears in the menu but no programme details were found.

languageOfInstruction.note: The admissions page requires English schooling or an English test (IELTS 6, TOEFL iBT 60, PTE 50 or Duolingo 85); no explicit teaching-language sentence was found.

programmes.name: Business Administration (multi-city BBA)
programmes.about: A four-year, 118-credit BBA with specialisations in Marketing, Finance or AI for Business; years 1 and 2 can be in Dubai.
programmes.overview: The degree combines 84 core credits, 18 specialisation credits, two regional immersion projects and a capstone. Subjects cover general business, specialised business and liberal arts. Assessment is continuous, with quizzes, projects, mid-term and end-term exams.
programmes.ib: IB Diploma of 24 or more points; no subject minimums are published.
programmes.selectionNote: Admissions Committee approval; the 24-point IB rule is a minimum.
